scope: D3 close-path redefinition, D4 practical-threshold exactness, D5 common-window component comparison ONLY. D1 and D6 unchanged.

D3_correction.problem: The real D3 functionals used 5m bar HIGH/LOW values (max/min excursion), but the frozen surrogate (5m_RETURN_TIME_OF_DAY_STRATIFIED_BLOCK_BOOTSTRAP) generates only a synthetic CLOSE-to-close log-return path -- it never synthesizes intra-bar high/low. The real and surrogate statistics were therefore not the same observable, even though both were labelled the same functional names. No synthetic high/low is invented to fix this; instead D3 is redefined so both real and surrogate paths are mechanically identical objects: a sequence of 288 5m CLOSE prices.

corrected_functional_definitions.TIME_TO_MAX_ABS_CLOSE_EXCURSION: earliest 5m bar offset (0-287) attaining max(MAX_UPSIDE_CLOSE_24H, MAX_DOWNSIDE_CLOSE_24H)

reason: the original D3 card allowed at most 2-3 functionals
the prior correction round accidentally expanded the surface to 4 (adding PATH_ASYMMETRY on top of the 3 excursion/timing functionals)
PATH_ASYMMETRY is derivative of MAX_UPSIDE_CLOSE_24H / MAX_DOWNSIDE_CLOSE_24H anyway and adds no independent information

D3_correction.real_and_surrogate_identity: close_k is used identically for both the real path (real future_bar_k.close, k=0..287, from CORE_BTC_BINANCE_V0) and the surrogate path (the cumulative-return-compounded close series already produced by the time-of-day-stratified 5m return bootstrap). No high/low field is read or synthesized by D3 in either case.

floors.MAX_UPSIDE_CLOSE_24H_floor: MAX_UPSIDE_CLOSE_24H >= 0 (if close never rises above entry_open, the maximum upside excursion is 0, not negative)
floors.MAX_DOWNSIDE_CLOSE_24H_floor: MAX_DOWNSIDE_CLOSE_24H >= 0 (if close never falls below entry_open, the maximum downside excursion is 0, not negative)

D3_correction.TIME_TO_MAX_ABS_CLOSE_EXCURSION_tie_hand: Earliest 5m bar offset wins any tie (retained from the prior correction's tie-handling convention).
D3_correction.entry_reference: entry_open = ev.get_perp_bar_opening_at(perp, t_ms).open -- unchanged, the same legally-known entry reference already frozen in the prior pre-execution correction.
D3_correction.null_family_kept: 5m_RETURN_TIME_OF_DAY_STRATIFIED_BLOCK_BOOTSTRAP (block length 12 bars, 1000 replicates, seed D3_NULL_SURROGATE_SEED=20260921103, companion block lengths 6/24, all slot-stratified) is UNCHANGED and now generates exactly the observable D3 needs: a synthetic 288-bar CLOSE path per replicate, computed identically to the real close path.

D4_correction.problem: ROLLING_CORRELATION_90D's practical_magnitude_threshold ('swings by at least 0.15 correlation-points peak-to-trough beyond null-implied noise') was not mathematically exact -- 'beyond null-implied noise' was not pinned to a specific computable quantity.

corrected_practical_gate.OBSERVED_CORRELATION_RANGE: max(real ROLLING_CORRELATION_90D series) - min(real ROLLING_CORRELATION_90D series)
corrected_practical_gate.NULL_RANGE_MEDIAN: median, over the 1000 BLOCK_BOOTSTRAP_PAIRED_RETURNS replicates, of [max(that replicate's ROLLING_CORRELATION_90D series) - min(that replicate's ROLLING_CORRELATION_90D series)]

D4_correction.statistical_gate_kept: ROLLING_CORRELATION_90D's realized variance across the interval exceeds the 97.5th percentile of the block-bootstrap null's implied variance -- UNCHANGED, retained alongside the now-exact practical gate (both must independently be checked; neither replaces the other).
D4_correction.LEAD_LAG_1DAY_status_unchanged: DEFERRED_FROM_SPRINT_01 (unchanged from the prior pre-execution correction).

D5_correction.problem: D5's own execution interval is correctly restricted to 2022-02-01T00:05:00Z -> 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z (bound by component_B/RULE_2's cross-venue data availability, per the first red-team review's F1 fix). D2 RULE_1 (component_A), however, reports its DELTA over its own full 2020-02-01 -> 2025-01-01 discovery interval. Comparing D5's DELTA against RULE_1's full-interval DELTA in the 'beats best component' check would compare statistics computed over materially different windows (different N, different sub-periods/regimes) -- not a valid apples-to-apples comparison.

corrected_comparison.COMPONENT_A_DELTA_FOR_D5: D2 RULE_1 (RV_ABSTENTION) evaluated on the EXACT D5 common interval, 2022-02-01T00:05:00Z -> 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z, NOT RULE_1's own broader 2020-2024 reported result. This requires RULE_1 to be evaluated a second time, restricted to this narrower window, solely to serve as this comparison input.
corrected_comparison.COMPONENT_B_DELTA_FOR_D5: D2 RULE_2 (DISLOCATION_ABSTENTION) evaluated on the exact same D5 common interval -- this already coincides with RULE_2's own native interval (both are 2022-02-01T00:05:00Z -> 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z), so no additional computation beyond RULE_2's own D2 result is needed here.

D5_correction.D2_RULE_1_own_result_unaffected: D2 RULE_1 may still separately report its broader 2020-2024 discovery result under D2's own card; that full-interval result is NOT replaced or overwritten by the D5-scoped, narrower-window evaluation. The narrower evaluation exists solely as an input to D5's comparison and is not itself a second D2 result.
D5_correction.pre_declared_not_post_hoc: This overlap-window comparison is a pre-declared requirement specific to D5, frozen now, outcome-blind. It must not be selected or adjusted after observing D2, D5, or any other card's outcome.
D5_correction.supersedes: The prior 'beats_best_component_check' language ('COMPOSED DELTA > max(component_A DELTA, component_B DELTA) from D2's own results') is corrected to reference COMPONENT_A_DELTA_FOR_D5 / COMPONENT_B_DELTA_FOR_D5 specifically, not D2 RULE_1's unrestricted full-interval result.

final_classification.D4: EXECUTABLE_DISCOVERY_SPEC (ROLLING_CORRELATION_90D only; practical gate now exact)
